slides.headline: He moved to the US at 12. In 2026, he became mayor of New Jersey's largest township.
Pulkit Desai was sworn in as mayor of Parsippany-Troy Hills, New Jersey, on January 3, 2026
slides.body: Born in India and raised in the United States from age 12, Desai became the first Indian-American mayor of Morris County's largest municipality, narrowly defeating the Republican incumbent.

slides.headline: A six-year Marine Corps veteran who served in Desert Shield and Desert Storm, he spent nearly three decades in cybersecurity at a Fortune 500 company before entering local politics.
slides.body: He won the mayoral race by a margin narrow enough that the incumbent legally contested it - and lost that challenge too.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: A Viksit Bharat benefits when its emigrants end up running American townships, not just American companies.
slides.body: Desai's path - India to the Marines to cybersecurity to the mayor's office - is local government increasingly shaped by people who started somewhere else entirely.
